Translation English: This mod adds clothing durability and repair to the game. Your clothing can now break over time and depending on the damage you (or other characters) take. Clothing can be repaired using sewing kits that you will find around the world.
Può essere utilizzato per riparare gli indumenti danneggiati.
column3: Can be used to repair damaged clothing.

Translation English: I miei vestiti si sono rotti!
